points.quote: `IDisposable` is the base contract. ... `Event.on…` subscriptions return an `IDisposable`, so a listener's lifetime is whatever holds its handle.
**`Disposable` (abstract base class):** an owner extends it and calls `this._register(x)`. Everything registered is disposed together with the owner.
**`toDisposable(fn)` and `combinedDisposable(...)`:** wrap cleanup logic ... **`DisposableStore`:** a bag of disposables.
**`MutableDisposable`:** holds one value. Assigning a new value disposes the old one, and disposing the holder disposes the current value.

`ensureNoDisposablesAreLeakedInTestSuite()` (`src/vs/base/test/common/utils.ts:53`) installs a tracker in `setup`. In `teardown`, a passing test fails with "There are N undisposed disposables!" and the creation stacks.
